headlines.title: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Monday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Advanced Micro Devices, Airbnb, DraftKings, L3 Harris Technologies, Molson-Coors, Nvidia,  Take-Two Interactive, Uber Technologies, and More
headlines.summary: Nvidia just lost a vote of confidence while AMD earned a $600 target, and Wall Street's chip debate is splitting wide open. Add a Fed rate hike looming and a flurry of fresh Citigroup calls, and Monday's analyst moves get interesting.

headlines.title: ABNB Q3 2026 deep dive: AI-driven product expansion accelerates growth and margin gains
headlines.summary: Online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 18.9% year on year to $4.87 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.16 per share was 10.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Airbnb's growth spurt comes with a catch
headlines.summary: Many Airbnb guests are using Reserve Now, Pay Later, creating a unique problem.

headlines.title: Airbnb Soars Over 11% After Strong FCF Results - What's the Best ABNB Play Now?
headlines.summary: Airbnb delivered strong Q3 revenue and free cash flow (FCF) results, with higher FCF margins. ABNB stock soared over 11% on Friday. Is it too late to get in? This article discusses some ABNB plays now.

headlines.title: Airbnb: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: Hotel listings pull first-time users in, and roughly a third of those guests go on to book a home within a year, a funnel that matters more than any single quarter.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
